records.question: 订单明细一共有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_items;

records.question: 数据库里一共有多少个客户?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_total, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_name) AS distinct_name FROM customers

records.question: 2014 年一共下了多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND order_date <= '2014-12-31'

records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2014%' AND oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       SUM(i.quantity) AS qty
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym;

records.question: Consumer 类型的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY cnt DESC

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(AVG(i.discount), 4) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY avg_discount DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: 利润为负的亏损明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loss_rows FROM order_items WHERE profit < 0

records.question: 运费最高的 5 行明细,列出行号和运费。
records.sql: SELECT row_id, shipping_cost FROM order_items ORDER BY shipping_cost DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: 美国的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS us_customers FROM customers WHERE country = 'United States'

records.question: 2013 年 12 月的总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2013-12'

records.question: 下单次数最多的 3 个客户,列出客户编号和订单数。
records.sql:
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 3

records.question: Technology 大类平均每行明细的销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_total, COUNT(oi.sales) AS rows_with_sales, ROUND(AVG(oi.sales), 2) AS avg_sales_per_row, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sum_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Technology'

records.question: 折扣不低于 0.3 的明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(discount) AS min_d, MAX(discount) AS max_d FROM order_items WHERE discount >= 0.3

records.question: 每种配送方式各有多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT ship_mode, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders GROUP BY ship_mode ORDER BY order_cnt DESC

records.question: 数量小于等于 0 的异常明细有哪些行号?
records.sql: SELECT row_id, order_id, product_id, sales, quantity, discount, profit FROM order_items WHERE quantity <= 0 ORDER BY row_id

records.question: 各市场的总利润分别是多少?
records.sql: SELECT g.market, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region GROUP BY g.market ORDER BY total_profit DESC

records.tags: 多表/时间/枚举陷阱/空结果
records.question: 2013 年 3 月亚太市场有多少订单?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2013-03'

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

records.question: 2013 和 2014 两年各自的总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS yr, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, COUNT(*) AS items
FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) IN ('2013','2014')
GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr;

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY profit_margin ASC

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
       SUM(o.amount) AS total_sales,
       AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount,
       MIN(o.amount) AS min_amount,
       MAX(o.amount) AS max_amount
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.sales) AS amount
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate'
    AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) o

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql: SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales FROM (SELECT sales FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sales LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL) % 2 OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL))

records.question: 每种订单优先级各有多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT order_priority, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders GROUP BY order_priority ORDER BY order_cnt DESC

records.question: 总利润最高的 5 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 2015 年 7 月到 12 月的总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_cnt,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2015-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2015-12-31'

records.question: First Class 配送方式的平均运费是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.shipping_cost), 2) AS avg_shipping_cost_per_line,
       ROUND(MIN(oi.shipping_cost), 2) AS min_cost,
       ROUND(MAX(oi.shipping_cost), 2) AS max_cost,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.shipping_cost), 2) AS total_cost
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.ship_mode = 'First Class';

records.question: 销售额缺失(sales 为空)的明细有哪些行号?
records.sql: SELECT row_id, order_id, product_id, sales, quantity, discount, profit, shipping_cost FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NULL ORDER BY row_id

records.question: 哪些订单的发货日期早于下单日期?列出订单号。
records.sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, ship_date, ship_mode, order_priority FROM orders WHERE ship_date IS NOT NULL AND ship_date < order_date ORDER BY order_date

records.question: region 为空的客户有哪些客户编号?
records.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, country, region, segment FROM customers WHERE region IS NULL OR TRIM(region) = '' ORDER BY country, customer_id

records.question: 剔除数量为 0 或负数、销售额为空的异常明细后,总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN quantity <= 0 OR sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_excluded,
       ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS all_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN quantity > 0 AND sales IS NOT NULL THEN sales ELSE 0 END), 2) AS clean_sales,
       SUM(CASE WHEN quantity > 0 AND sales IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_kept
FROM order_items

records.question: 每种客户类型(segment)各有多少个客户?
records.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customer_count DESC

records.question: 各市场分别有多少个客户?
records.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(g.market, '(未知/区域缺失)') AS market, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_cnt
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
GROUP BY COALESCE(g.market, '(未知/区域缺失)')
ORDER BY customer_cnt DESC

records.question: 2012 年每个月各有多少张订单?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2012-01-01' AND order_date < '2013-01-01'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym

records.question: 销售额最高的 5 行明细,列出行号和销售额。
records.sql: SELECT row_id, sales FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: 客户数量最多的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: 三个商品大类各有多少张订单(按订单号去重)?
records.sql:
SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY order_cnt DESC

records.question: 2014 年按月的利润趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.sales), 0) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

records.question: 按配送方式统计总销售额。
records.sql: SELECT o.ship_mode, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.ship_mode ORDER BY total_sales DESC

records.question: 没有任何商品明细的订单有几张?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_total, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_items FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM order_items) oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id

records.question: 折扣正好为 0 的明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_discount_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items) AS total_rows FROM order_items WHERE discount = 0

records.question: 库里最早和最晚的订单日期分别是哪天?
records.sql: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS earliest, MAX(order_date) AS latest, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders

records.question: 累计消费总额最高的 3 个客户,列出客户编号和消费总额。
records.sql:
SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.customer_id
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 3

records.question: 各国家的总利润分别是多少?
records.sql: SELECT c.country AS country, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY total_profit DESC

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的市场是哪个?
records.sql:
SELECT g.market, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit)/SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL AND oi.sales != 0
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC

records.question: Technology 大类 2014 年的总销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_sales_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Technology' AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(AVG(oi.profit), 2) AS avg_profit, COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.profit IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0 ORDER BY avg_profit

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC
